Simulation results as a long table

Source: R/workflow.R
as.data.frame.mc_sim.Rd

Simulation results as a long table

Usage

# S3 method for class 'mc_sim'
as.data.frame(x, row.names = NULL, optional = FALSE, zeros = FALSE, ...)

Arguments

x

An mc_sim object.

row.names, optional

Not used.

zeros

Keep absences?

...

Not used.

Value

Data frame with site, species, step and abundance, from history, or from abundance with step as NA if no steps were recorded. tibble::as_tibble() turns it into a tibble.

See also

Other simulation studies: equilibrium_check(), run_scenarios(), summary_stats()

Examples

set.seed(1)
sim <- simulate_metacommunity(landscape_implicit(4), species_traits(5),
                              competition_matrix(5, "none"), n_steps = 10,
                              seed_steps = 1:2, record_steps = c(5, 10))
head(as.data.frame(sim))
#>    site species step abundance
#> 1 site4     sp2    5        87
#> 2 site1     sp3    5         1
#> 3 site2     sp3    5        12
#> 4 site3     sp3    5        31
#> 5 site1     sp4    5         6
#> 6 site2     sp5    5        22
